title: Prototype chain
description: Every object has a hidden link to a prototype. Property lookup walks this chain until found or null. class extends sets it up; hasOwnProperty filters own keys, `in` walks the chain.

notes: Lookup walks: instance → ClassName.prototype → ParentClass.prototype → Object.prototype → null.
Methods declared in a class body live on the prototype (shared), not on each instance.
hasOwnProperty checks only own keys; `in` returns true for inherited keys too.

questions.q: Where does `d.speak()` find `speak` for `const d = new Dog()`?
What does `class Dog extends Animal {}` do to the prototype chain?
options: Copies Animal methods to every Dog instance
